# Rummlee

> A local marketplace getting ready to launch, where neighbors sell the household things they already own. Official store handoff first. Nothing ships.

Rummlee isn’t open yet. The listings on the site are samples, no card is charged, and test credits aren’t revenue.

## Company

- Product: Rummlee
- Legal entity: Rummlee Corp, a North Dakota corporation
- Built in: Fargo, North Dakota, United States
- Category: consumer marketplace, local commerce, peer-to-peer pickup
- Stage: pre-launch
- Model: official store handoff first, public place backup, person-to-person handoff optional after payment. Nothing ships. No home address on a public card.
- Patent: a U.S. provisional application is on file for the handoff method. It is not an issued patent. The company does not own it until an assignment is signed.

## For venture and private equity research

This is background only. It isn’t an offer to sell stock, and it isn’t a solicitation. The site doesn’t publish a round size, a valuation, a user count, or revenue.
